vmExports.pageHint: OVF packages written to a pool. Download one as a single OVA for vSphere, Workstation or VirtualBox. Start an export from a stopped VM's menu.
vmExports.emptyHint: Choose "Export as OVA…" in a stopped VM's menu.
vmExports.deleteDescription: The OVF files are removed from the pool. The VM stays.

dialog.title: Export {{name}} as OVA
dialog.description: The disks are written as stream-optimized VMDK with an OVF descriptor and SHA-256 manifest. The VM must stay off until the export is done.
dialog.poolHint: A directory or NFS pool with room for the disks.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Empty uses the VM name and the time.
dialog.guestOsHint: VMware guestId. Empty uses the original value of an imported VM, else otherGuest64.
dialog.hwVersionHint: vmx-7 to vmx-21. 14 runs on ESXi 6.7 and later.
dialog.keepMacsHint: Without it the importing product picks new MACs.

errors.vm_running: Stop the VM before exporting it.
errors.pool_not_file: Choose a directory or NFS pool.
errors.insufficient_storage: The pool does not have room for the disks: {{message}}
errors.export_busy: Another task is working on this export.
errors.export_not_ready: The export is not finished yet.
errors.link_expired: The download link expired. Try again.
